radish-daikon.label: Radish
radish-daikon.why: Clean Daikon seed is normally direct-sown; routine chemical pretreatment is optional here.

hocl.note: Radish-sprout research does not establish a routine treatment for coir-grown Daikon microgreens.

peroxide.note: No mold-control protocol is selected here for your direct-sown Daikon seed.

spray.note: 30–50 ppm HOCl was studied on radish sprouts; that is not a daily coir-tray recommendation. Peroxide tolerance is not mold-control proof.

broccoli.label: Broccoli
broccoli.why: Direct sow clean seed. If treatment is needed, distinguish the broccoli research below from routine advice.

hocl.note: Tested on broccoli; follow a suitable product’s edible-seed directions. Your 200 ppm stock cannot reproduce 800 ppm by dilution.

peroxide.note: Not effective in the broccoli head-to-head test. The separate 12% × 15 min result assessed bacteria.

spray.note: The seed-bath study does not establish a daily HOCl or peroxide spray protocol.
